svg.title: Automatic affine fitting and optional B-spline coefficient optimization
svg.desc: The upper mechanism fits each of four centred orientation starts through Gaussian smoothing factors four, two and one on an unchanged image grid, with up to 256 updates at each level. The lowest final metric selects the six-parameter physical affine A, from fixed to moving micrometres. The optional lower mechanism refines one B-spline lattice from 1000 through 500 to 250 micrometre spacing. Its nodes remain fixed within each level; ASGD updates their vector coefficients. A query after A blends its 16 surrounding coefficients. The enlarged support is linked to that exact four-by-four neighbourhood and shows the same fitted vector values and the resulting local query shift. The optimizer update ends on a learned coefficient card linked to its vector at a fixed node. The compact coefficient update uses Delta c for the ASGD-computed change. At every update, 4096 new paired intensities form the 32 by 32 bin Mattes mutual information calculation. A bending penalty with relative weight 0.05 also contributes to the parameter update. Separate labeled choices keep the global alignment or add B-spline refinement; both routes reach one overlay review and save action. Tissue contours, lattice coefficients and sampled locations share one schematic transformation. No native fitting is run.

g.text: E = A or E = B ∘ A
